title: The Auction Within the Auction | Market Analysis for the Week of 11/15/2026
ref_note: No roll this week (Dec contracts; roll expected week of 12/13). Title is 'The Auction Within the Auction | Market Analysis for the Week of 11/15/2026'. ES list starts 'Will add higher if needed' and ends 'See last week’s for lower'; NQ list is bounded by 'See last week’s for higher/lower'. NQ '28200-28233* Monitor for Failed reclaim' has a non-LAAF/LBAF tag, so tag '' and no tag trade (wnq2 is the commentary failed reclaim). ES sub-sections ('Trading Within the Balance' trades filed by direction). Compound sentences: wes9/wes10 split one sentence with two explicit if/then trades (LAAF above 7670-7680, LBAF below 7490-7504); wes6 keeps only the short half (the 'buyers slight advantage above 7593-7600' half is wes7). wes2 mindful = the list levels between 7708-7713 and 7746.25 (7725-7730, 7738-7741), which he calls 'the intervening levels' without numbers. wes3 mindful 7369-7372 comes from the next sentence ('remains an important intervening reference'). wes8 gate uses Friday's RTH open/high 7641-7643 from the preceding sentence. wnq8 Friday's low has no NQ number (FRI_LOW). wnq13 'recent lows' unnumbered (likely the 26366.5 ETH low); NQ 'this past week’s RTH low' (wnq11) unnumbered; 'last quarter’s low' unnumbered. Tag trades kept for NQ 26369-26408 and 26258-26291 because the 26366.5 sweep (wnq14) is not stated as at those levels. Not made trades (borderline): NQ 'Above 28200–28233 / Below 28096–28129' distribution definitions and 'my initial expectation is that sellers will attempt to establish control of this area' (transition 28096-28233, kept as a zone); NQ 'a reclaim of 29038–29069 would represent a major accomplishment for buyers' (no target); NQ 'While the move from 27313–27339 down to 26969–26987 looks relatively clean, we need to remain mindful ... around 27201.5' (same idea as wnq13); NQ 'The 28200–28233 to 28400–28443 range also looks reasonably rotational' and 'range between 27588–27622 and 28096–28129 as reasonably rotational'; NQ 'we’ll respect the potential for sellers to defend these areas' (28583-28608/28684-28722, no wary wording); NQ second break of last quarter's low 'considerably more devastating' vs 'unwilling to dismiss the possibility of a substantial bullish defense' until the prior-ATH backtest fails (no levels); NQ 'premature to become overly bearish on the first meaningful pullback'; ES 'range between 7490–7504 and 7558–7563 to be reasonably rotational'; ES 'Sustained strength above 7593–7600 would place ES firmly back within Friday’s A-period single prints' (no target); ES 'I’ll be particularly attentive to failed auctions' in 7558-7600. Fib refs (50% = Tuesday's excess low, 38.2%) have no numbers.

cautions.quote: At that point, I would pause for a fresh assessment, particularly given the importance of the 29,000 area and the unfilled bearish RTH gap extending from 28969 to 29405.
I plan to treat 28969, or any higher high established this week, as the potential upper boundary of a developing multi-week balance and would therefore become increasingly cautious with longs.
However, given buyers’ limited success sustaining trade above 7649 this past week, I would weigh that possibility against the potential for renewed selling within the high-volume area.
